quests.title: Antiquity Hunt: Conclusion

dialogue.t: Oh? Have you found all the replicas?
Marvelous! You really do have a knack for this, don't you?
Well then. This gift is for you. Thanks for taking part in the event organized by our Darshan.
I hope that you've been able to enjoy your taste of archaeology, Traveler.
That said, real-life archaeology tends to be rather dry and labor-intensive work...
But the instant you find that key relic, you will feel as if the struggle was all worth it.

dialogue.sit: And if you fail to dig anything up?
I'm quite sure there are situations in which you find nothing.

dialogue.t: Well, if we don't find anything, then this is, as they say, "a waste of effort."
And to be honest, this is actually what happens more often than not. The instances where we do find something important are quite rare indeed.
But to work in archaeology is to be used to such circumstances and stay optimistic even so. It would only be a matter of time before we collapsed otherwise.
